Frequently asked questions

Can I use free assets in a commercial project?

Only if the asset’s license says so. Every listing shows a license summary before you download. Free License assets allow personal use and monetised streams with attribution; CC0 assets allow any use; Standard and Extended licenses cover commercial work as described on the asset page.

What file formats are included?

Each asset lists exactly the formats it ships with (for example PSD, SVG, PNG, FBX or WAV). PLAYGROUND never lists a format or software compatibility that the download does not actually contain.
